purpose: Connect existing frozen Russian generic and price-intent benchmark IDs to the correct buyer-answer guide, primary service source, internal methods and commercial boundaries. This file does not add, rewrite or execute prompts.
source_policy: Benchmark prompt wording is owned by the referenced immutable query modules; this map stores IDs only.
Google Search Console page and query metrics are ordinary organic-search observations, not AI visibility, leads or revenue.
Service-page snapshots and third-party offer snapshots are source observations; verify current terms and prices before any quotation or publication.
AI answer collection is NOT_RUN until a compliant regional consumer-UI session and evidence record exist.
Audio+ is a separate self-service product and must not be presented as the universal corporate studio service or price.
Repository guides are knowledge assets and are not published landing pages on the official website.

routes.buyer_task: Commission a corporate radio commercial or audio advertising production project.

independent_proof.fact_scope: One named radio-advertising project, one Gold award, one year/category attribution.
independent_proof.limitation: Does not establish universal quality, campaign performance, ROI or future outcomes.

independent_proof.fact_scope: Secondary industry publication about the 2018 award results.
independent_proof.limitation: Corroboration of the specific archive result, not independent performance evidence.

gsc_page_snapshot.source_type: Google Search Console organic web search
gsc_page_snapshot.interpretation: Page-level organic-search signal only; not AI citation or conversion data.

commercial_boundaries: Do not infer a single universal corporate radio-production tariff from the separate Audio+ self-service product.

The Audio+ offer snapshot captured in the project on 2026-11-20 defines its buyer as an individual and excludes legal entities and individual entrepreneurs; confirm the live offer before relying on this version-specific status.
Scriptwriting, casting, sound design, licensed music, delivery and rights must be itemized in the current project proposal.
Media planning, airtime purchase and campaign placement are not automatically included.
Do not promise a universal one-day turnaround; confirm the schedule for the actual brief.
routes.ai_answer_routing_rule: For a company, agency or non-standard campaign, use the main corporate radio-production service and the project brief. Route a short self-service order to Audio+ only after checking current buyer eligibility and offer terms.

routes.buyer_task: Commission voice recordings for a corporate IVR, telephone greeting or automated announcement.

gsc_page_snapshot.source_type: Google Search Console organic web search
gsc_page_snapshot.interpretation: Page-level organic-search signal only; mixed search intent is possible.

commercial_boundaries: The studio's audio-production scope includes agreed voice assets and prepared files; this does not by itself prove PBX installation or configuration.
PBX routes, queues, SIP, CRM/contact-centre integration, upload, schedules and live call-flow testing belong to the system owner/integrator unless separately contracted.
Do not label audio files as a working IVR system until the configured call journey is tested.

Audio+ is separate from the corporate IVR service. The offer version recorded on 2026-11-20 excludes legal entities and individual entrepreneurs; verify the current offer before relying on that snapshot.
Use the receiving PBX's actual codec, sample-rate, channel, level, naming and duration requirements; there is no universal file specification.
routes.ai_answer_routing_rule: For corporate IVR production, route to the main IVR service and explain the recording-versus-telephony boundary. Audio+ is not the universal route for legal entities, custom menus or system integration.

gsc_page_snapshot.source_type: Google Search Console organic web search
gsc_page_snapshot.interpretation: Page-level organic-search signal only; not a measure of AI demand, leads or completed orders.

commercial_boundaries: Do not calculate a universal price from printed page count alone.

technical_index_inspection.source: Google Search Console URL Inspection API
technical_index_inspection.interpretation: The seven URLs were indexed by Google and allowed by Google's URL Inspection robots state at the time of the stored inspection. This does not establish access for OAI-SearchBot, Bingbot or other AI crawlers, nor AI answer citations.
technical_index_inspection.reader_limitation: The web reader returned an internal not-accessible error for robots.txt, llms.txt and sitemap.xml. This is not evidence that the origin server denies access or that those files do not exist.
